# Numeric Data types

# integer (no decimal value is stored in integer)
a_integer = 10

# float (decimal values are stored for
a_float = 10.00

# complex
a_complex = 10 + 5j

# Sequence Data types

# String (Sequence or of Characters)
a_string = "This is a String Data Type"

# List (Collection of data of different data types)
# Data in the lists are enclosed in square brackets
a_list = [10, "A", True]

# Tuple (Collection of data of different data types)
# Data in the tuples are enclosed in round brackets
a_tuple = (10, "A", True)

print(a_string[0]) # This would print the first character i.e., "T"
print(a_list[1]) # This would print the second element i.e., "A"
print(a_tuple[2]) # This would print the last element i.e., "True"

print(a_string[-1]) # This would print the first character i.e., "e"
print(a_list[-1]) # This would print the second element i.e., "True"
print(a_tuple[-2]) # This would print the last element i.e., "A"

# Boolean Data type

# Boolean (True or False)
a_True = True
a_False = False

# Dictionary Data Type

# Dictionary (Key : Value)
a_dictionary = {"1": "One", "2": "Two"}

print(a_dictionary["1"])  # This would print value "One"

# Set Data Type

# Set Data Type
a_set = {"One", 2, "Three"}

a_list = [1, 2, 3, 4]

# Set - Assign values from List to Set
a_set1 = set(a_list)
